concepts.description: A structural unit of the AUV system that encapsulates components and interfaces.
A physical or logical platform within the AUV module that interacts with sensors and actuators.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate, specifying values and events.
A logical component within the AUV module responsible for managing operations and responding to inputs/outputs.
A basic data type defined within AUV_Module to represent fundamental values such as numbers, strings, or booleans.
A structured data type defined within AUV_Module that groups multiple named values of potentially different types.
A named data field within an Interface that holds a specific type of data for use by components of the AUV system.
A named signal or action defined within an Interface that can be triggered by components of the AUV system.
A named computational unit defined within AUV_Module that takes inputs and returns a result.

instances.description: The module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system that uses the Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to receive sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to control actuators.
The controller within AUV_Module that manages operator-level commands using the Inputs interface.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
The Last Response Engine controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands.
The autopilot controller within AUV_Module that uses the Outputs interface to control autonomous navigation.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values (true or false).
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording north-south relative distance, east-west relative distance, depth, id, and heading values.
A value of type real within the Sensors interface representing the depth measurement.
A value of type SVec within the Sensors interface representing the heading direction.
A value of type Obstacle within the Sensors interface representing a detected obstacle.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that specifies input events for controlling AUV operations.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, signalling the end of a task.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an OCM operation.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a MOM operation.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an HCM operation.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and a return value of type real, requesting a velocity value.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and a return value of type real, requesting a heading value.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a heading.
A composite type recording horizontal closest distance of approach, vertical closest distance of approach, and an id of type nat.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
